recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17067; future work on PATCH/history constraints should proceed under later Bundle history issues rather than this definition clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-17067 was a Published FHIR-core Feed change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that Bundle.entry.request.method replace confusing wording about an HTTP verb in change history/transaction response with wording that distinguishes transaction/batch actions from history-bundle actions.
initial_application: The change was applied in d42cd49796fe3e12715410956582c715a370b749 (GF#17067 / svn 14373), which changed source/bundle/bundle-spreadsheet.xml to the approved wording. Later source refactors, including 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 and c69d71aa213de86d55e0261339c15e4bacd509e6, preserved that wording in source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml still describes history bundles as entries whose request elements describe the change made. Searches found no later final Jira, Zulip, or Confluence decision changing this definition. Related FHIR-17173 and FHIR-34388 concern separate history-processing details, while FHIR-50118 remains unresolved and outside this seed decision.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml already defines Bundle.entry.request.method as: In a transaction or batch, this is the HTTP action to be executed for this entry. In a history bundle, this indicates the HTTP action that occurred.
